read_examples_from_file: read NER training examples from a CoNLL-2003 format text file into InputExample objects
convert_examples_to_features: convert InputExample objects into tokenized InputFeatures with BERT-style input IDs, masks, and segment IDs
get_labels: load NER label list from a file path or return default CoNLL-2003 labels
create_InputExample: create an InputExample object with a unique guid, list of words, and optional labels for token classification
create_InputFeatures: create an InputFeatures object with input IDs, input mask, segment IDs, and label IDs for model input
